translations.web: Wake up righteously, and don’t sin, for some have no knowledge of God. I say this to your shame.
translations.bsb: Sober up as you ought, and stop sinning; for some of you are ignorant of God. I say this to your shame.
translations.kjv: Awake to righteousness, and sin not; for some have not the knowledge of God: I speak this to your shame.
translations.asv: Awake to soberness righteously, and sin not; for some have no knowledge of God: I speak this to move you to shame.
